title: Switch Drawing MicroSim

creator: Dan McCreary

learningObjectives: Distinguish the open (OFF) switch symbol, with its lever lifted away from the contact, from the closed (ON) symbol that bridges the gap

Draw switch symbols in both open and closed positions in horizontal and vertical orientations within a circuit diagram
